transmission: ☀️ Daylight Sanctuary, Seamless Day/Night Toggle & Human-First Version History.

details: Daylight Sanctuary (Light Mode): Introduced full light mode support across all themes with warm porcelain and sunlit cream tones, offering soothing eye comfort and astigmatism-friendly high contrast for daytime study.

Tri-Theme Daylight Adaptation: Every aesthetic mode now shines in daytime—Sunny Iris blossoms into a sunlit botanical garden, Astronaut transitions into a cleanroom aerospace laboratory, and Cosmos delivers luminous daylight telemetry.

NASA Aerospace Discipline: Real-world spacewalk aesthetic featuring deep space contrast, clean spacesuit ceramic surfaces, and luminous Earth orbital blue framing.
Sidebar Quick-Cycler: Positioned a seamless 1-click theme cycler with tactile audio feedback directly on the sidebar for effortless aesthetic transitions without leaving your flow.
